messages.text:
Hello,

I'm seriously considering purchasing the Magic M. 40T from Batch 10, but
I would like to clarify a few details before placing my order.

1. Does the stock Magic M. OS have a 0% mandatory developer fee?
Specifically, is 100% of the miner's hashing work directed exclusively to
my configured mining destination, with no automatic developer mining,
hashrate diversion, or other recurring software charges?

2. Can I configure any custom Stratum server without restrictions? I intend
to solo mine BTC and potentially merge mine Fractal Bitcoin (FB), initially
through a third-party solo service and eventually using my own nodes and
private Stratum server.

3. Is Magic M. OS fully functional without a subscription, paid
activation, or ongoing connection to your services?

4. Are there any restrictions on installing other firmware or updating the
stock firmware?

5. Are the current 30, 36, and 42 TH/s power profiles available without
additional fees or subscriptions?

6. Has Batch 1 started shipping to customers? Is December 21, 2026 still
the realistic shipment date for Batch 10?

7. Can I cancel a Batch 10 preorder for a full refund if the shipment is
delayed or if the product specifications change? How long after placing the
order is cancellation permitted?

I would appreciate written confirmation, particularly regarding the
zero-fee operation and compatibility with a privately hosted solo-mining
setup.

Thank you.
Handed to the team · Firmware fee, stratum and lock-down facts are not in the product facts; will not

Note to the team: I flagged questions 1 to 5 for JD, our hardware lead, and wrote back to the customer with what I could confirm myself: Hello, Thank you for the careful questions. Since you asked for these in writing, I'd rather give you answers you can rely on than guesses. On questions 1 to 5 (…

Hello,

Thank you for the update. I look forward to hearing back from the team soon.

Respectfully,

Derek G.

Hi Derek,

Thanks for your patience. Your firmware questions are with JD, our hardware lead. The team picks them up today at 10am ET, and his answers will come to you here in this thread.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
